bullets.title: NVDA: Beat/raise on earnings but stock down 25% YTD amid CEO turmoil, SEC probe, China chip halt
bullets.body: NVDA reported Q3 revenue $115.8B (+103% y/y), beat by ~6%; Q4 guided $130B; raised FY28 growth to ~75% from 70%. Board ruled out reinstating Jensen Huang; ARM CEO Rene Haas reportedly approached as successor. SEC opened civil probe into potential accounting issues (Reuters); NVDA halted Hopper/H200 shipments to China (~$2.4B quarterly impact). Stock extended decline to -47% from ATH by Nov 20, with UBS cutting PT to $220, Jefferies to $250, Piper to $230, Wolfe to $200—all maintaining Buy/Outperform. GS maintains Buy at $220 PT. New US BIS export controls restrict overseas data center remote access to US AI chips, adding pressure.

bullets.title: INTU: FY27 guidance cut on Credit Karma AI headwinds; Mailchimp sold for $3.68B; PT cuts across the board
bullets.body: Intuit Q1 revenue $4.35B beat by 1.2% but Credit Karma guided to 3-7% FY27 growth vs prior 11-13% as AI-powered discovery shifts consumer behavior. FY27 revenue guidance cut to 8-9% from 9-10%. Mailchimp sold to Bending Spoons for $3.68B (~70% discount from $12B purchase price). Stock fell ~10% on print. Mizuho cuts PT to $380 (Outperform), UBS to $315 (Neutral), KeyBanc to $375 (Overweight). Stock trading at 9x NTM FCF, lowest in years.

bullets.title: CRWD/ZS: CrowdStrike said to be in talks to acquire Zscaler; ZS +18% AH
bullets.body: Bloomberg reported CrowdStrike is in acquisition talks with Zscaler; ZS shares surged 18% in after-hours trading on the news. No terms disclosed.

bullets.title: BILL: TPG/Corpay take-private at $63.25/share ($6B); stock downgraded across Wall Street
bullets.body: BILL agreed to be acquired by TPG (majority) and Corpay (minority, ~$1.1B for ~1/3 stake with 2030 buyout option) at $63.25/share in all-cash deal—31% premium to 60-day VWAP, ~4.2x EV/NTM revenue. Transaction expected to close 1H27. BILL downgraded by JPMorgan, UBS, Jefferies, KeyBanc, Needham, TD Cowen, and others; Mizuho raises PT to $63.25 (Neutral, deal price caps upside). CEO René Lacerte to remain.

bullets.title: ORCL: Secured all OpenAI funding; targets $30B+ FCF in FY29; $225B+ revenue by FY30
bullets.body: Oracle confirmed it secured all funding needed for its OpenAI contract, with $10B equity and $10B debt raise complete. Abilene campus (Astra-6 training site) nearly complete; Vera Rubin rack handover on track. FY27 revenue guidance >$90B (+34% y/y cc); FY30 revenue targeting >$225B at 35%+ CAGR; non-GAAP operating margin >40% by FY30. Positive FCF expected H2 FY28, targeting self-funding by FY29. Stock down 52.6% YTD but JPM retained Overweight.

bullets.title: GOOGL: JPM reiterates OW at $375 PT on Gemini model cadence acceleration; YouTube ~$3B school settlement; Waymo freeway ban
bullets.body: JPM reiterates Overweight with $375 Dec-27 PT. Google released three Gemini 4 models in <1 month (Carbon, Hydrogen, Neon); Hydrogen powers global Search; Gemini Tasks launched to 1B+ users. Cloud +103% y/y with $561B backlog. Meanwhile, YouTube is finalizing a ~$3B settlement with schools over social media addiction claims (jury found Google/Meta liable in March 2026). California banned Waymo from freeways after two incidents; Waymo temporarily removed vehicles from US highways nationwide. UBS cut GOOGL PT to $320 (Neutral).

bullets.title: AVGO: Google cutting 2027 Broadcom TPU shipments ~20%, shifting to MediaTek design
bullets.body: Ming-Chi Kuo reported Google is cutting 2027 Broadcom-designed TPU 8i series shipments by ~1M units (~20%), mostly higher-priced 8i Max/Whalefish models, due to data center power constraints and shifting to MediaTek-designed TPU 8t series. GS maintains Buy on AVGO.

bullets.title: DIS: Q4 beats on EPS/revenue; FY27 guided to double-digit adj EPS growth; $3B cost-cut program; dividend raised 33%
bullets.body: Disney Q4 EPS $1.77 beat consensus $1.67; revenue $25.95B beat $25.16B. FY27 adj EPS guided to double-digit growth (consensus was +8.5%). Plans $9B buyback and $26B content spend in FY27. Dividend raised 33% to $2.00/share. $3B annual opex savings targeted by FY29. HK/Shanghai parks remain under pressure. UBS upgrades to Buy; Citi Buy at $140 PT; JPM reiterates OW.

bullets.title: AMD: Down 8%+ on Hunterbrook short report alleging China exposure; OpenAI 14% GPU design improvement validation
bullets.body: AMD fell 7-8% after Hunterbrook Capital published a short report alleging AMD chips reached sanctioned Chinese entities (IEIT Systems). AMD disputed allegations. Separately, OpenAI reported 14% PPA improvement on AMD GPU design using AI-driven SystemVerilog optimization in <5 months—a positive for AMD's AI silicon credibility. AMD also completed acquisition of World Labs (~$8.2B all-stock; Fei-Fei Li joins as EVP/Chief Scientist). Commerce Dept approved ~879K NVDA/AMD AI chip sales to China (some to military-linked entities), drawing Congressional scrutiny.

bullets.title: MDB: UBS upgrades to Buy, $450 PT; MongoDB acquires Firebolt for real-time analytics
bullets.body: UBS upgraded MongoDB from Neutral to Buy, raising PT to $450 from $375 (47% upside) citing durable 20%+ revenue growth and 25%+ Atlas growth. MongoDB also acquired Firebolt for real-time analytics integration. Separately, Hedgeye moved MDB to Short Bench following CEO CJ Desai's departure for Meta and additional exec exits (CCO, AI head), flagging large enterprise deal risk.

bullets.title: DELL/HPE: Consensus previews into earnings; DELL AI-server ramp key; HPE FAA router issue
bullets.body: DELL reports Nov 24: consensus $49.3B revenue (+150% ISG y/y), $6.62 EPS; AI-Optimized Servers $19.83B in Q3 guidance. Options imply ~14.6% move. HPE reports Nov 23: consensus $14.47B revenue, $1.28 EPS. FAA paused HPE router installation linked to Nov 13 nationwide ground stop. JPM favors DELL and HPE into prints on strong AI demand; DELL up 31% since Sep 1.

bullets.title: TTWO: GTA VI sets records—$3.79B day-one retail sales, 99 Metacritic, 3.3M peak Twitch viewers
bullets.body: Take-Two's GTA VI achieved $3.79B in day-one retail sales (UBS estimated $3.6B for full F27), 32.5M presold units, and a 99 Metacritic score (tied all-time). Twitch peaked at 3.31M concurrent viewers (5.5x prior gaming record); GTA VI comprised 68% of all Twitch viewing at peak. Each 10M unit boost = ~$600M upside vs. $8.0-8.2B bookings guidance. UBS maintains Buy.

bullets.title: CCL/RCL: Cruise channel checks bullish—Caribbean +5% YOY, premium brands outperforming; Norwegian lagging
bullets.body: UBS cruise channel check shows overall booking volumes mid-to-high single digit YOY through mid-Oct, recovered post-election. Caribbean pricing +5% YOY; Europe +6%; Alaska +7%. CCL's Celebration Key/Princess outperforming on strong marketing; RCL Celebrity strong. Norwegian flat to +1% pricing vs. peers +3-7%; aggressive promotions through wave season. CCL ordered two new ships (3,690 berths) delivering 2033/2035; Celebration Key water park delayed to 2030. UBS Buy on CCL at $36 PT; MS raised PT to $32.50.

bullets.title: SPOT: CFO at TMT signals mid-teens revenue growth through 2030; AI Remix near Q1 2027 launch
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley maintains Overweight on SPOT at $700 PT (~30x FY28e FCF). CFO guided mid-teens total revenue growth through 2030 from subscriber growth, pricing power, and ad acceleration. Gross margin target 35-40% by 2030. AI Remix licensing agreements signed with UMG, Believe, Kobalt; Q1 2027 launch pending artist opt-ins. LYV partnership 'Reserve by Spotify' expanding to Europe/Australia in 2027.

bullets.title: CRM: Opco maintains Outperform at $275 into Dec 2 earnings; stock down 30% since September
bullets.body: Oppenheimer maintains Outperform on CRM with $275 PT. Expects 3Q beat with 100-150bps M&A contribution from Contentful/FIN. F3Q CRPO consensus ~$34.1B with 200bps upside potential. Agentforce adoption progressing but monetization gradual; stock pop off earnings expected but sustained re-rating requires clearer organic reacceleration. ServiceNow reportedly building AI-powered CRM tool targeting Salesforce customers. JPM partner surveys show AI adoption real but enterprises face data quality, process readiness barriers.

bullets.title: MSFT: Ignite reinforces AI monetization; ByteDance Azure deal; July bug caused major outage
bullets.body: Microsoft's Ignite conference reinforced full-stack AI thesis: strong Azure/M365 demand, Copilot Cowork traction, E7 adoption. ByteDance in advanced talks to spend ~$500M on Azure for OpenAI models. MSFT released data showing Copilot significantly undercuts Anthropic/OpenAI on price. July software flaw (undetected since July) triggered cascading Outlook/Teams outage affecting ~half a billion people. RBC maintains Outperform at $640 PT; Citi Buy at $680 PT.

bullets.title: BABA: Q2 cloud +67% YOY beats; AI labs losses narrowing; EPS missed; stock down 42% YTD
bullets.body: Alibaba Q2 cloud external recurring revenue +67% y/y (vs ~50% expectations); cloud EBITA margin expanded to 14.5%. Combined AI Labs + Applications losses narrowed to RMB1.7bn from RMB8.2bn QoQ. EPS CNY8.10 missed FactSet CNY10.88. Capex fell from peak. Cloud growth guidance cut to 30-45% next year on US export controls; FY30 target $100B external cloud at >20% margins. JPM maintains OW at $200 PT; Mizuho raises PT to $205 (Outperform).

bullets.title: WSM: Q3 comp miss on Pottery Barn weakness; stock down ~15%; analysts trim PTs
bullets.body: Williams-Sonoma Q3 comps +5.1% missed consensus +5.6% due to Pottery Barn deceleration (+1.8% vs +5.1% prior Q); West Elm +7.0%, WS +6.8%. EPS $2.38 beat by +8.7% on tariff refunds. FY26 guidance reiterated. Q4 guidance wide range creates uncertainty; fuel/freight costs headwinds. Citi cuts PT to $245 (Neutral), KeyBanc $270 (Overweight). First comp miss in over two years; stock had been near 25x peak valuation.

bullets.title: HOOD: Added to Wolfe Alpha List at 23x 2028E EPS; Mizuho bullish on wealth-creation expansion
bullets.body: Wolfe Research added HOOD to its Alpha List, trading at 23x 2028E EPS at the low end of historical range (20-60x); fundamentals remain strong with pipeline of revenue-enhancing products. Mizuho (Outperform, $130 PT) met with CEO/CFO: prediction markets at 30% non-sports volume, banking/cards growing, retirement AUM >$35B, agentic trading at 200K accounts. HOOD down ~36% QTD. Separately, Kalshi acquired FB Securities for stock trading launch, sending HOOD down 7%.

bullets.title: BE: Morgan Stanley raises PT to $335 (Overweight) on third guidance raise; BMO upgrades to Outperform
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley raises Bloom Energy PT to $335, maintaining Overweight, following the company's third guidance raise of the year on demand from new end markets (utilities, international, C&I) and continued margin expansion. BMO Capital Markets also upgraded BE to Outperform. BE saw 100+ prospective customers at recent event and is expanding internationally, including a potential 370MW Lone Oak project in Texas.
